description: The committed ogg/external-opusenc-16-pink-side-12-db.opus (opusenc, opus-tools 0.2, libopus 1.4, at 16 kbit/s, 4 s of stereo pink noise (a mid signal and a side signal 12 dB lower) at 48,000 Hz), decoded with opusdec.

encoder.name: opusenc
encoder.command: opusenc --bitrate 16 in.wav external-opusenc-16-pink-side-12-db.opus; opusdec --rate 48000 external-opusenc-16-pink-side-12-db.opus out.wav

tools: LAME 3.100, vorbis-tools 1.4.2 (oggenc, oggdec), FFmpeg 6.1.1-3ubuntu5 (aac), opus-tools 0.2 with libopus 1.4 (opusenc, opusdec), flac 1.4.3 (Ubuntu 24.04)
